## Summary

I collected data from Elon Musk's X.com profile (@elonmusk) while logged out, since no credentials were available in this environment. X.com only renders 5 posts to unauthenticated visitors before blocking further content behind a login wall — confirmed via screenshot evidence.

All 5 accessible posts had relative timestamps of 8 hours or less (1h, 5h, 5h, 6h, 8h), consistent with being posted today.

**Published artifacts:**
- `artifacts/elonmusk_tweets_today.csv` — the requested CSV with exactly the columns `text, likes, time_posted` for all 5 tweets visible today
- `artifacts/elonmusk_profile_view.png` — full-page screenshot evidence showing the profile, the tweets, and the login wall that limits further scrolling
- `artifacts/notes.md` — documentation of the access limitation (logged-out X.com view) and why only 5 tweets could be captured

Note: Because X.com restricts unauthenticated access to a small number of posts per profile, this CSV reflects all tweets visible without login credentials — if Elon Musk posted more tweets today beyond what the public logged-out view exposes, those are not included here.
